methodology.initial: 2 Base + 1 Advanced; choose simultaneously, pass right, add Advanced; all 6 choices free
methodology.recovery: 8 current-tier cards + 4 tokens; each player takes one card and one token; visible lower tiers may replace current tier; unpicked cards return
methodology.tokens: Each physical reward card in a conserved attempt awards one token at module end, no cap by type
methodology.dice: All real engine rules, own-color wild star, persistent freeze, multiple ±1 tokens, full free-dice rerolls
methodology.controllers: Four-die profile explicitly drafts a usable 4-die card and opens with it when it has at least one adjust and one reroll; card ranking uses empirical precomputed success rates, never future rolls. Other profiles unchanged.
methodology.differencesFromProduction: Sandbox-only catalog/draft/token patches; isolated planner counts all card rewards, uses fresh odds and avoids trial-landing mutations
methodology.moduleBonus: V2 diverse conditions; physical face snapshots and real actions for scoring; all goals require at least two banked tricks. Planner uses explicit heuristic probabilities for unknown future faces/actions; no bonus is awarded from those estimates.
methodology.fourDieProbe: On Boucle du Lagon the four-die profile plays a cheap two-die helper before its Epic, instead of forcing the Epic to open. All commands use actual engine rules.
